publication_scope_check.interpretation: Unphysical data-only subtraction and reranking, not a realizable optimization or new benchmark; no claim of reclaimable duration.

observations: Latest same-source ordinary p95 remains 2.100001-2.110000 ms; instrumented query p95 is 2.140001-2.150000 ms. This fixed-order pair establishes parity and attribution, not a reliable isolated overhead estimate or gate pass.

Query parse plus materialize is 0.222357% overall and 0.304787% of the same 108 whole-tick tail frames (7.6915 us mean on those selected frames). The previously open query-marshalling ambiguity is resolved negatively; repeating attribution or implementing marshalling changes is not justified.

All query source masks refer only to gameplay slot0. Stress slot1 performs the original 9,999-row numeric writes and actual checksum reads; its inclusive callback time is not proven exclusive interpreter/opcode time.

Native navigation execute dominates query tail time (83.938711 ms), but graph-cache/repeated-start/endpoint-only proposals are not new candidates; their preserved measured or same-row-subtraction negative outcomes remain binding.

Numeric prepare/validation and publish-global costs remain inclusive measured regions. Existing ordered-query and matrix-basis experiments did not establish adoption; an aggregate duration does not establish removable checks or a safe new algorithm.

Loan buffers are foreign views over native ECS data, not guest copies; native undo storage already reuses capacity and keeps required rollback copies. Pinned QuickJS integer-index typed reads already have a direct fast path. Prior store/loop/PGO changes were measured negative or mixed.

The reviewed script/runtime/navigation/QuickJS/Core paths differ from the latest measured producer only by the unused-in-ScriptTick has_world_text helper; no distinct new source hot-path regression was found. Other source/compiler changes are not claimed measured by the historical pair.

Publication concentration was also checked: only seven rows exceed 100 us, median 1.541 us. Removing its entire duration in an unrealizable same-row model still leaves reranked instrumented p95 at 2.113082 ms. This does not support a publication-only route to the target.
recommendation: Stop this bounded source/data reassessment without a new experiment or optimization branch. The 2 ms requirement remains unmet. Revisit after a concrete changed callback/VM/typed-view-validation path or source-bound evidence of a distinct expensive operation; do not repeat unchanged query parsing/materialization, PGO, navigation, deadline or numeric-query experiments.

conditional_measurement_contract.discard_criteria: Any logical/PCM difference, weakened workload/limits/rollback/observability, invalid/partial timing, or unstable/nonrepeated paired improvement rejects adoption. Never pool marginal quantiles, drop outliers, or change the 2 ms threshold.
